<think>
The compilation errors stem from Jetty’s API changes between 8.x and 11.x. The key breaking changes affecting this class are: removal of SelectChannelConnector, moving the “send server version/date header” settings from Server to HttpConfiguration, and the removal of setPort/getLocalPort from the generic Connector interface. The fix is to use ServerConnector with HttpConfiguration and HttpConnectionFactory, update imports accordingly, change the connector field type from Connector to ServerConnector, and set/get the port via ServerConnector. These are minimal changes that align with Jetty 11’s API. Other errors (e.g., in JadlerHandler) are separate, but this patch addresses all issues in JettyStubHttpServer highlighted by the error log.
</think>
